Definition: a road (as trodden); figuratively, a course of life or mode of action, often adverb
BiblicalUsage: The way is the most ordinary picture in the Bible and one of the deepest: a road walked, a journey taken, and the manner of a whole life. Abraham is told to keep the way of the Lord, Israel is told to walk in all His ways, God teaches sinners in the way, and Proverbs promises He will direct our paths.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the way is the whole of the Christian life in one word. God does not hand us a map and leave us to find it; He walks the road with us, and His own ways, higher than ours, are the ones that lead home.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
